steps.prompt: Before the check: which pattern from Missing Number Thinking do you use most, and which do you still have to think about?
steps.placeholder: I use… I still think about…

cards.title: Missing numbers: quick review
cards.body: Undo the operation: undo $+$ with $-$, and $\times$ with $\div$. In $? - 18 = 25$ the missing number is the whole: $43$. Check by putting your number back in.

cards.title: Balance: quick review
cards.body: $=$ means both sides are the same. In $45 + 28 = 47 + ?$, the $45$ went up by $2$, so the other number goes down by $2$: $26$.

cards.title: How the check works
cards.body: First a short warm-up. Then the check: $8$ questions, easiest first, no hints. Type each answer. You need all $8$ right to pass. If you miss one, you’ll see how to do it, and the next try gives you new numbers.

prompts: Where could you use a pattern from Missing Number Thinking outside school?
Which pattern will you keep practising until it is automatic?
